taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Signed OAuth request object validation and outer-parameter precedence
controls.source_trace: Resolve signature trust and the authoritative source of client, redirect, scope and transaction fields when signed and unsigned parameters coexist.
controls.implementation_branch: Select the exact JAR/profile and its signed-only requirements, outer client_id consistency and permitted outer-only parameters. Check issuer/audience/time, registered key and duplicate handling. Safe signed precedence can be correct; not every conflict requires rejection. Request objects, fetched request_uri objects, PAR and JARM are separate mechanisms, not interchangeable validation results.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned issuer fixture keep a valid request object constant and vary one unsigned conflicting field; observe which value drives authorization.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A signed JWT string is not proof of correct binding, but a rejected conflict is not a bypass either.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Validate request-object context and authoritative parameter handling; verify legitimate signed requests and rejection or safe signed precedence for conflicting inputs under the selected profile.
